payload.title: Support immutable binary stdin in managed commands
payload.summary: Complete the maintained managed-command roadmap obligation for binary standard input. Add stdin: bytes | None = None to the existing immutable public Command specification, plus with_stdin(bytes) replacement and without_stdin() removal. None preserves current inherited-stdin behavior; configured bytes (including empty bytes) must be delivered exactly through a child pipe followed by EOF. Accept only immutable bytes or None at construction; invalid types must raise TypeError, including fluent replacements. Preserve command value/hash semantics and stdin through every existing fluent operation. Feed input while both output streams are drained so large input and a child that writes large output before reading cannot deadlock. Early child input closure/exit remains an ordinary CommandResult, not an unhandled pipe error. Existing timeout/cancellation cleanup must still bound blocked input and reap the immediate child. Preserve argv, cwd, output/event retention and result identity, without shell execution or parent-global mutation. Investigate the existing source and dependencies; do not change tests or acceptance. Independent behavior, original regressions, Ruff, formatting and strict typing are mandatory.
payload.benefit: Use managed commands for consumers that require binary stdin without shell workarounds or global mutation.
payload.uncertainty: Distinct fresh task following narrow repair of nested stale observation projection. Not a retry of failed environment task; no protected publication authority.
dependencies: Existing managed child lifecycle, independent output drains and immutable Command
